title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant
Salary: £28,000-£30,000 per annum, depending on experience
Location: Bredbury with office move to Central Stockport in Spring 2027
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Working Pattern: Primarily office-based, with hybrid working available following successful completion of probation

Client Details

We are looking for a detail-focused Accounts Assistant or Accounts Payable Specialist to join an experienced finance team on a full-time, permanent basis. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their career within finance and become an important part of a busy and supportive accounts function.

Description

The key responsibilities of an Accounts Assistant will include:
- Processing purchase and sales invoices
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and delivery documentation
- Assisting with accounts payable and accounts receivable
- Processing payments and maintaining accurate supplier and customer records
- Reconciling bank and control accounts
- Supporting month-end processes and reporting
- Maintaining accurate financial records and filing
- Assisting the wider finance team with general accounting and administrative duties

Profile

A successful Accounts Assistant will have:
- Previous accounts payable experience - essential
- Knowledge of CIS and DRC VAT - highly desireable
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Strong organisational skills
- Excellent time-management skills
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to work independently and manage competing priorities
- A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with colleagues across different departments
- Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office
- Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365/ Business Central / NAV would be advantageous

Job Offer
- £28,000-£30,000 per annum, depending on experience
- Primarily office-based in Bredbury with Hybrid working available following successful completion of training/probation
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays
- Free on-site parking
- Company pension scheme
- Private medical cover
- A varied role with exposure to all areas of accounts
- A collaborative and supportive working environment
- The opportunity to develop your skills and become a key member of the finance team

title: Lettings Coordinator
description:
Lettings Coordinator

Stockport

If you're someone who loves keeping things organised, supporting people and being the calm, capable voice behind a busy operation, this role will suit you perfectly. Our client is a fast-growing rental housing owner building a brand-new leasing and resident support function from the ground up. They're investing heavily and creating modern rental communities across both single-family homes and multi-family apartments.

You become the human support layer behind a modern, automated leasing journey. You're the person prospects, residents and leasing consultants turn to when they want real help, not a bot. It's a varied, people-focused role, ideal for someone who enjoys structure, communication and keeping a process moving smoothly.

What You'll Be Doing:
- Supporting enquiries that automation can't resolve - WhatsApp, calls, emails, booking viewings and sending property details.
- Managing viewing calendars and keeping consultants' diaries accurate.
- Guiding prospects through applications, referencing, Right to Rent and tenancy sign-off.
- Overseeing referencing SLAs with our third-party partner to keep move-ins on track.
- Refreshing listings with accurate imagery, EPCs, council tax bands, pricing and descriptions.
- Providing resident support through touch-base calls and general admin as the role grows.
- Keeping CRM records tight - logging enquiries, updating statuses and ensuring no lead goes cold.
- Feeding back insights on pricing, objections, viewing trends and resident experience.

What We're Looking For:
- Lettings or property experience - agency, BTR, coordination, resident services or hospitality.
- Strong communication across phone, WhatsApp and email.
- CRM confidence and comfort with modern systems.
- Accuracy and organisation - listings, details and deadlines matter.
- Understanding of lettings compliance or willingness to learn.
- Calm, service-first mindset with the ability to handle variety and change.

What's In It For You:
- £28,000 base salary
- Quarterly bonus (OTE £30,000)
- Modern systems, AI tools and automated workflows
- Clear progression, leadership here promotes internally
- Join at the start of something big. Huge investment, huge growth, huge opportunity
- A role with variety: listings, resident support, CRM, admin, SLA oversight, customer contact

title: Bankruptcy Administrator
description:
Bankruptcy Administrator - Manchester

Acting Agency: Imperium Financial Recruitment

Imperium Financial Recruitment is proud to be working with a highly regarded and growing insolvency practice in Manchester, seeking a Bankruptcy Administrator to join their expanding team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with experience in personal insolvency to take the next step in their career. You will be responsible for managing a caseload of bankruptcy files from start to finish, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements while delivering excellent service to clients.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing your own portfolio of bankruptcy cases.
- Liaising with creditors, debtors, and other stakeholders.
- Preparing reports and statutory documentation.
- Ensuring cases are progressed efficiently and in line with deadlines.
- Supporting the wider insolvency team as required.

Ideal Candidate:
- Previous experience working within personal insolvency or bankruptcy administration.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a busy team.
- Good attention to detail and a proactive approach.

Location: Manchester

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

If you are looking to progress your insolvency career in a forward-thinking firm, this is the perfect opportunity.

title: Air Freight Imports Coordinator
description:
Air Freight Imports Coordinator

Location: Greater Manchester
Salary: Competitive + Benefits

Reed is delighted to be partnering with a well-established international logistics organisation seeking an experienced Air Freight Imports Coordinator to join its growing operations team. This is an excellent opportunity for an air freight professional who enjoys managing shipments from arrival through to final delivery while ensuring high levels of customer service and operational accuracy.

The Opportunity

Working within a fast-paced freight forwarding environment, you will oversee import airfreight shipments, liaising with overseas partners, airlines, customs authorities, transport providers and customers to ensure cargo moves efficiently and compliantly.

The successful candidate will be highly organised, customer focused and confident managing multiple shipments simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate international air import shipments from pre-alert through to final delivery
- Monitor shipment progress and provide timely updates to customers and stakeholders
- Arrange customs clearance activities and ensure all import documentation is accurate and compliant
- Liaise with overseas agents, airlines, haulage providers and warehouse partners to facilitate smooth cargo movement
- Verify supplier costs and prepare customer invoicing in line with agreed commercial arrangements
- Resolve operational issues, delays or service disruptions with a proactive approach
- Maintain accurate records within the freight management system
- Ensure all shipments are processed in accordance with regulatory requirements and internal procedures
- Support customer retention through consistent service delivery and effective communication
- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service performance

About You
- Previous experience within air freight forwarding, with a particular focus on imports
- Good understanding of customs procedures and import documentation requirements
- Strong knowledge of the international freight and logistics sector
- Ability to prioritise workload in a time-sensitive environment
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- Strong attention to detail and administrative accuracy
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications
- Experience using freight forwarding software would be advantageous
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

What's on Offer
- Join a respected and expanding logistics business
- Supportive and collaborative working culture
- Career development and progression opportunities
- Competitive salary and benefits package

To find out more about this confidential opportunity, please contact Adam Norris at Reed or apply now.

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Recruitment Coordinator
Sale, Manchester
£28,638 - £29,497 per annum upon successful probation period
Permanent, Full Time (37.5 hours per week)

Please note, this role is office based only

Stockdales is a charity based in Sale, just south of Manchester City Centre, with a wealth of experience in making a difference to children, young people and adults with learning disabilities.

We are seeking a Recruitment Coordinator to play a key role in helping us attract, recruit and welcome the people who make a difference across our organisation. It's a varied role where no two days are the same, giving you the opportunity to build relationships, get involved in recruitment events and use your creativity to attract new talent.

So, if you have exceptional communication and organisational skills, experience working in a recruitment role and share our passion for recruiting the top talent, then we would love to hear from you!

About the role

You'll support the full recruitment and onboarding process, from completing pre-interview questionnaires and coordinating applications to assisting with, and where appropriate conducting, interviews across our care homes and services. You'll use our Applicant Tracking System (IRIS) every day to manage candidate applications, maintain accurate records and ensure information is kept up to date.

You'll also be out and about representing Stockdales at job fairs and recruitment events, helping to promote our vacancies and connect with potential candidates. Using Canva, you'll create engaging recruitment adverts for social media and help identify the most effective channels for reaching new applicants. You'll also support the development of relationships with recruitment agencies and explore new ways to build our candidate pool. From time to time, you may also help deliver presentations about Stockdales and the opportunities available to join our team.

Alongside your recruitment responsibilities, you'll provide a range of general administrative support to the team. This will include answering calls and responding to queries from professionals, colleagues and external contacts, preparing induction packs, maintaining departmental records and databases, organising meetings and appointments, and producing reports and documents using Microsoft Office.

It's a role that combines people, organisation, creativity and communication - perfect for someone who enjoys variety and wants to make a real contribution to building great teams.

About you

Our ideal candidate will be an experienced recruitment and onboarding professional who is confident conducting interviews and has experience using an Applicant Tracking System (ATS). With strong interpersonal and administrative skills, you will be highly organised, able to multitask and prioritise a demanding workload, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

You will be IT proficient, with experience using a range of computer software including Microsoft Office, databases, email, and internet-based programmes. Experience in public speaking or delivering presentations to groups is also desirable. You will be reliable, proactive, and motivated to improve processes, with the ability to provide practical solutions in a calm and methodical manner. A full driving licence and access to a vehicle is essential.

What you will receive whilst working for us:
- 28 days holiday per year pro rata inclusive of bank holidays
- Increased holiday entitlement with service
- Pension Scheme
- Medicash - includes access to 24hr GP, money off shopping and going out, wellbeing aids
- Life Insurance Scheme
- Excellent internal and external training
- Monthly staff prize draw
- Stream - Access to salary early
- Ongoing professional development, guidance, and support from experienced managers.
- Friendly, supportive environment.

Come and join our amazing team and help us achieve our mission - to help people live their lives to the full so they can experience the hope, joy and challenge that life brings.

Please refer to the job description upon submitting your application.

Stockdales is committed to being an equal opportunities employer, with a values-based recruitment process.

title: Accounts Assistant - Purchase Ledger & Credit Control
description:
Location: Trafford Park, Manchester
Salary: £26,436.80 per annum
Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm

Are you an organised and detail-driven finance professional who enjoys taking ownership and keeping things running smoothly? We are looking for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join our established Manchester team in this varied role covering both Purchase Ledger and Credit Control.

Reporting to the wider Finance Team, with a dotted line to the Site Managing Director, you'll play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting cash flow and building strong relationships with both customers and suppliers.

You'll be responsible for processing and reconciling supplier invoices, matching purchase orders, resolving discrepancies, preparing payment runs, monitoring customer accounts, chasing outstanding debt and handling account queries professionally. You'll also produce reports, maintain accurate records and ensure issues are followed through to resolution.

We're preferably looking for someone with previous accounts, purchase ledger and credit control experience, excellent Excel and IT skills, and proven Kerridge/Autoline expertise. You'll be highly organised, resilient and confident managing competing priorities, with the communication skills to handle challenging conversations while maintaining excellent customer and supplier relationships.

This opportunity could suit someone currently working as an Accounts Assistant, Purchase Ledger Clerk, Credit Controller, Accounts Receivable Assistant or Finance Administrator. Like what you see? CLICK APPLY and send through a copy of a CV.
